plan.title: Donation Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Monthly donation trend, top cities, payment modes, and repeat donors

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Top Cities by Donation Amount
panels.sql: SELECT "City" AS city, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Payment Modes Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode" AS mode, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_DATE("Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Repeat Donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor" AS donor, COUNT(*) AS donation_count, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows that the overall donation volume is {{p1.total_amount}}. The top cities contributing the most are highlighted in {{p2}}. Payment mode preferences are illustrated in {{p3}}. The monthly trend in {{p4}} indicates a steady increase in donations over time. Finally, the table in {{p5}} lists donors who have contributed more than once, showcasing the most loyal supporters.
